note: review fixes from the 2026-09-30 consolidated review (worktree review-fixes), incl. the four handed over by host-dist

items.title: `naima new` overwrites an existing item on a case-insensitive filesystem or under concurrent runs
A stale local copy of another branch's claim overrides that branch's newer claim
A property's `holds` status survives a change to the property, verifier, model path or options
A status of `__proto__`, `constructor` or `toString` is accepted as a valid item status
An adapter's out-of-contract verdict silently erases the property's status
Trunk detection fails on a non-`main`/`master` trunk, and detached HEAD is mishandled
`naima release` of a claim the trunk already carries brings the claim back
`naima new --set <bad>` fails but leaves a half-made item on disk
`naima triage derive` stamps negated evidence as `measured`
`meta.json` is typed but never validated on read, and a malformed field crashes commands
On Windows, backslash paths break cross-branch reads and the beta-marker skip filter
Cross-branch reads start O(refs x files) git subprocesses on every call
Launcher coverage is lost, and several commands have no test at all
The dependency-rule test (`src/arch.test.ts`) enforces less than it claims
Core commands can be silently shadowed by a plugin command, and some kinds skip collision checks
Both directions of a link can be stored for the same relation
Non-Latin titles collapse to the same slug, and are flagged as false duplicates
`naima show`/`naima set` with an empty reference silently acts on the only item
A `date` field accepts an impossible calendar date
Some stray item directories are invisible to `naima check`, or only get a note
Three independent file walkers with their own skip rules, and one returns non-file entries
A beta marker naming a closed item is reported as "no such item"
The example regex verifier adapter counts a phantom last line
The features-documented check accepts an empty or directory-only `docs` reference
Setext-style markdown headings produce no anchors for the links-resolve check
The gated-proof-is-gated check ignores its own documented "or ranks below" clause
Numeric command arguments are not validated
`naima prune` skips stale claims that live only on other branches' refs
The gates option documentation names a config file that does not exist
The generated reference embeds the current project's configured gates
The inverse-link cache goes stale within a single run
Field access goes through an untyped index signature
Verifier inputs are unchecked: an undeclared field, an unchecked cast, and a path-escape
`naima triage` packs four subcommands into one hand-rolled dispatcher
Grouping items by array spread is quadratic
The plugin registry and config are mutable at run time
Three separate git wrappers with different error semantics
Untyped error model, and command exit code 75 is shared between relaunch and ordinary commands
Non-atomic writes, and a vendored program update deletes the program before the new checkout lands
No lint or formatter wired into the toolchain
